name: Citrus! K.O.
source:
You're on your way to submit a late assignment and daydreaming about putting your blorbo in situations... when he seemingly comes to life and (accidentally)  hits you with a soccer ball!!! ⚽⚽⚽⚽

...Is it the possible-concussion talking or is he kinda into you too? 

A silly micro visual novel where your favourite character seemingly comes to life and checks you for concussion symptoms.

[From [url=https://zacbytesgames.itch.io/citrus-ko]itch.io[/url]]
